prompt_md: In an office, 60% of the staff drink tea and 70% drink coffee. What is the smallest possible percent of the staff who drink both?
prompt_short: 60% drink tea, 70% coffee. Smallest possible percent who drink both?
hint_md: Try to keep the two groups apart. How much do they spill over 100%?
explain_intuition_md: Multiplying to get 42% assumes tea and coffee habits are independent, but nothing says so. Squeeze the groups apart and 60% plus 70% still overshoots everyone by 30%.
